# shmuelie-dotnet

.NET, C# interop, Roslyn, WinUI 3, MSIX, and application assets.

**Version:** 0.1.1

```text
copilot plugin marketplace add shmuelie/shmuelie-skills
copilot plugin install shmuelie-dotnet@shmuelie-skills
```

See the [plugin & skill reference](../../../docs/plugins.md#shmuelie-dotnet),
